licence.firstPartyData: Fictional demo rows, illustrative figures and Design-state documents only; no licensed catalogue, personal data or supplier rights are granted.

rejectionRules: Any change that adds fixed, reused or real credentials to source, fixtures, workflows or documentation.
Any change that calls a real age, KYC, sanctions, payment, marketing, custody, model or supplier provider from this prototype.
Any change that removes or weakens a fail-closed prototype, profile, adapter, launch or evidence gate.
Any unlabelled forecast, unverified catalogue assertion, jurisdiction activation or readiness overclaim.
Any stale generated test count, documentation inventory or canonical number duplicate.
Any asset, dataset or code submission without licence, provenance and permitted-use evidence.
Any regulated claim without a named legal/compliance reviewer and review date.

review.cadence: Every repository-policy change and at least quarterly

evidenceGaps: No named individual holds the policy owner or approver role in this workspace.

Branch protection with 15 required Phase 1 checks and code scanning are enabled on the public repository, but no GitHub DCO app or independent reviewer is configured; DCO sign-off and distinct-review approval remain policy checks rather than enforced repository settings.
No contributor signature, asset provenance record or third-party asset submission has been attached.
